purpose: Teach: 人道/倒す/信徒/激化/国税/紙幣/財界/原動力

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人道支援、寄付を通じて、続けていけ、企業の責任として、社員にも、伝えろ。
lines.en: We'll continue our humanitarian work and donations as a corporate responsibility. Make sure the staff understands that.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear enunciation on key phrases. Slight pause between the values and the directive. Calm but expectant — a senior giving instruction, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合を、市場で、倒す力、当社、養ってまいります、製品力、強化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're building the competitive strength to outpace our rivals in the market. We're reinforcing our product capabilities.
lines.style: Attentive, methodical. Each clause lands with deliberate clarity. Respectful pace — keeping up with the boss's tempo. Professional but engaged, not rote.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者は、宗教の信徒でも、なかったが、信念は、確かに、持っていた人物だった。
lines.en: The founder wasn't a religious man, but he held his convictions with certainty.
lines.style: Slower tempo, reflective. Quiet weight on 「確かに」 — a private recognition. Gazing inward slightly. Speaking something true almost to himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。グローバル競争、激化しております、海外展開、加速、必要です、来期から、特に。
lines.en: Yes. Global competition is intensifying. We need to accelerate our overseas expansion, especially in the next fiscal year.
lines.style: Crisp, business-ready delivery. Structured progression through the points. Slight emphasis on 「特に」 to underscore priority. Professional without strain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国税の対応、社内、いつも、最優先で、行え、コンプラ、徹底だ、絶対に。
lines.en: Tax compliance and our internal protocols — handle those as the absolute top priority every time. Thoroughness is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. Sharp articulation on 「絶対に」. Not harsh, but brooking no misunderstanding. The voice of someone who has seen what carelessness costs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新紙幣対応、社内システム、来月、完了予定です、お客様、ご安心ください。
lines.en: Yes. We're on track to complete the system updates for the new currency next month. Our customers can rest assured.
lines.style: Positive assurance underlying the update. Clear and competent pacing. A slight warmth when acknowledging customers — professionalism with care baked in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、財界の重鎮として、私も、責任ある発言、心がけてまいります、社員に、模範を、示す。
lines.en: As a leader in both industry and business, I'm mindful of speaking responsibly. I want to set that example for the staff.
lines.style: Measured, almost reflective. Not grandiose — grounded accountability. Slight pause before 「責任ある発言」 as if weighing the words. Speaking a standard he holds himself to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のやる気こそ、当社の、最大の原動力です、社員、大切にしてまいります、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff's morale is truly our greatest asset. We're going to continue valuing them, genuinely and fully.
lines.style: Warm conclusion. Tempo slightly slower on the final stretch. The word 「本当に」 lands with sincerity — not closing a meeting, but affirming a principle. Genuine conviction underneath.
